description: Search long-term memory (full-text, BM25) ranked with proximity, recency and importance. Also reports chunks where matching ores/logs were counted and storage holding matching items. Without a query, lists what is remembered near you. Pass ids for full entries. Entries this session already received are listed as 'already sent' — pass fresh:true to repeat them.

fresh.description: Repeat entries already sent in this session.

query.description: Free text, e.g. "iron", "village", "where did I leave diamonds".

radius.description: Only memories within this many blocks of you.

name: recall
title: Search memory
